rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the changes extend deep owners behind interfaces smaller than what they hide. The EQDB transport (§6) dispatches one request type through `RemoteEddbExtractor` and hides framing, the ssh process and the per-request refusal contract behind it; `read_signal_map_observation` hides the store read, interpolation and time-base refusal behind one function; the §7 pin table hides four-machine keying behind one lookup. No new family of small wrappers is introduced.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan repairs two duplicates correctly (§2's exporter COCOS resolver; the §6 probe-angle census, which names `read_geometry_table`'s `probe_angle_source` branch as the one supplier on the description route), but leaves a census of duplicate owners live and one section that depends on an owner it never names.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; every section that adds surface names in its own text what it retires/merges or why nothing can. §2 adds one public resolver and retires the exporter's private copy; §6's EQDB transport adds three public types and states "retire nothing, because no equilibrium-database request type exists" (and no exception family is added — its refusal is a record, not an `EddbRemoteError`); §7 retires the three `PINNED_*` constants and the arm's re-export, and adds the machine table.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — every mechanism the plan proposes names an existing owner, and each was opened in the tree and found: the COCOS resolver `imas_ambix/data/transform_engine.py:411` `_target_cocos_transformation`; the sign scorer `imas_ambix/data/cocos_convention.py:346` `score_convention` and the signal-map reader `imas_ambix/data/cocos_convention.py:804` `read_signal_map_observation`; the Grad–Shafranov kernel `imas_ambix/challenge/convention.py:283` `measure_convention` (already landed); the transport `imas_ambix/data/eddb_remote.py:283` `RemoteEddbExtractor` and store `imas_ambix/data/eddb.py:210` `write_channel`; the probe-angle selector branch `imas_ambix/data/description_reader.py:253`; the pin table owner `imas_ambix/gs/artifact_resolution.py:69`; the identity registry `imas_ambix/gs/machine_identity.py:145` `default_registry`; the referee `imas_ambix/eval/efit_referee.py:272` `judge_geometry` and builder `imas_ambix/worldmodel/equilibrium_labels.py:465` `build_geometry_from_arrays`; and the drive-turns fix in `imas_ambix/gs/operator.py` (`ampere_turns_per_ampere`, `COIL_MODEL_VERSION = "source-stated-drives"`).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the one thin addition is §2 promoting `transform_engine._target_cocos_transformation` to public so `tokamap_export` calls it instead of its own `_cocos_transformation` (`imas_ambix/data/tokamap_export.py:147`). That is an anti-wrapper move: it deletes a fork rather than adding a layer, and the plan justifies it (an importer must not reach into a private symbol and must not fork it either).
